batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)

transfer delegates execution to transferFrom
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances
ensure calls condition() for non-whitelisted addresses
condition() is reachable from transferFrom through ensure()
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value without overflow-safe math
transferFrom performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without overflow-safe math
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping

ensure honours the tradeAddress whitelist bypass
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum

condition() enforces the _minSale threshold
condition() enforces the _maxSale threshold

init writes _maxSale from maxToken
